rule: D4/D5 contrast = distance to paramagnetic prototype minus distance to FM prototype for kappa<.5 or AP prototype for kappa>=.5. Primary positive -dcontrast/dh peak; no nearest-reference selection. Fixed .05 position tolerance to SAME predefined RN order-response target m0/AP, retain all peaks/endpoints.
reference: Independent same-N ED order response, supported physical interpretation assessed separately with Mx/Binder/spectrum/sizes. Detector-on-ED labels never used as truth.
D5_SV: Unmeasured high-order wall histogram, explicit missing result. No free full-state projection.
training: Only independently labelled clean development reference plus validation; no p/coordinate inputs at prediction.
shots: Exact and32x100k full-window runs, shared stored counts. No hidden voting.
